title: :target the dialog!
description: Here’s a small CSS-hack I came up with while working with the UI for LogiFront 2.0: Use the CSS :target pseudo-selector for dialogs/popups, until the <dialog>-tag has better browser-suppor
body_html:
Here’s a small CSS-hack I came up with while working with the UI for LogiFront 2.0:

Use the CSS :target pseudo-selector for dialogs/popups, until the <dialog>-tag has better browser-support.

Here’s the idea, simplified:

<a href="#myDialog">Open dialog</a>

<dialog id="myDialog">
  <h2>Hello world!</h2>
  <a href="#">Close dialog</a>
</dialog>

And the CSS:

dialog {display: none;}
dialog:target {display: block;}

LogiFront 2.0 UI

Go to demo.logifront.com to view extended examples.
All the links at the left sidebar (“Controls”) are using dialog/target.
LogiFront is an online tool for building apps and forms – watch the introduction video here!
